name: WTK
recent: WTK 近期完成两项资产处置：股东在 2026 年 10 月 6 日特别股东大会上通过以 RM221.50 million 出售 Positive Deal 65% 股权及种植园资产给 Trinity Capital Resources；同时全资子公司 Loytape Industries 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日签约以 RM38 million 出售槟城三块工业租赁地及地上资产给 NationGate System。董事经理 Dato' Sri Patrick Wong Haw Yeong 在 9 月底至 10 月初多次小额增持公司股份。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会通过以 RM221.50 million 出售 Positive Deal 65% 股权及种植园资产给 Trinity Capital Resources。
全资子公司 Loytape Industries 签约以 RM38 million 出售槟城三块工业租赁地及地上资产给 NationGate System。
董事经理 Dato' Sri Patrick Wong Haw Yeong 在 9 月 29 日至 10 月 2 日期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
risks: 董事经理在 9 月底至 10 月初的多次股份交易属于上市条例第 14 章下的闭市期外交易，需留意后续持股变动披露。
公司于 2026 年 9 月 28 日公告行业分类调整（Reclassification of Sector）。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，WTK 营收为 RM195.19 million，环比增长 48.7%，同比增长 41.3%；净利为 RM60.52 million，环比增长 732.7%，同比增长 247.1%，净利率从上一季度的 5.5% 升至 31.0%。

recent_en: WTK recently completed two asset disposals: shareholders approved the disposal of 65% equity interest in Positive Deal and plantation assets to Trinity Capital Resources for RM221.50 million at an EGM on 6 October 2026; meanwhile wholly-owned subsidiary Loytape Industries signed an SPA on 30 September 2026 to dispose three industrial leasehold land parcels with assets in Penang to NationGate System for RM38 million. Group Managing Director Dato' Sri Patrick Wong Haw Yeong made several small acquisitions of company shares in late September to early October.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the disposal of 65% equity interest in Positive Deal and plantation assets to Trinity Capital Resources for RM221.50 million at an EGM.
Wholly-owned subsidiary Loytape Industries signed an SPA to dispose three industrial leasehold land parcels with assets in Penang to NationGate System for RM38 million.
Group Managing Director Dato' Sri Patrick Wong Haw Yeong acquired company shares on several occasions in the open market between 29 September and 2 October.
risks_en: The Group Managing Director's multiple share dealings in late September to early October were outside closed period under Chapter 14 of the Listing Requirements; further changes in shareholding disclosures should be monitored.
The company announced a reclassification of sector on 28 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, WTK's revenue was RM195.19 million, up 48.7% QoQ and 41.3% YoY; net income was RM60.52 million, up 732.7% QoQ and 247.1% YoY, with net margin rising to 31.0% from 5.5% in the previous quarter.
